[rules_primary]
If Tamara Zidansek wins the Zidansek vs Jeong professional tennis match in the 2026 WTA Seoul Qualification Round 1 after a ball has been played, then the market resolves to Yes.

[rules_secondary]
The following market refers to the Zidansek vs Jeong professional tennis match in the 2026 WTA Seoul Qualification Round 1 after a ball has been played. If the match does not occur (signaled by a ball being played) due to a player injury, walkover, forfeiture, or any other cancellation (all before the match starts), the market will resolve to a fair price in accordance with the rules. If this match is postponed or delayed, the market will remain open and close after the rescheduled match has finished (within two weeks).
